title: National Museum of Pakistan

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified terrain at the main Burns Garden approach, just outside the photographed entrance.

mapIdentity.scope: OpenStreetMap relation 7605753 records the approximately 48 m by 64 m museum envelope, two enclosed courtyards, and a 37 m section of west facade where the Burns Garden pedestrian approach meets the building.

note: The garden entrance has a projecting sign canopy under nine cream masonry screens set against dark openings. The red fascia separates this base from the repeated concrete fins, two rows of inset glazing and two stepped folded rooflines.
